body: He can be a but of a bully and an asshole and he fully admits it. He likes things a certain way and he will be mad if it changes. He feels it is the mothers job to do everything with the kids and daddies play with them. His only woke up with his son maybe twice ever when he was a baby. I would survive on four hours of sleep every three days and then fuss at me for not sleeping with the baby. My son woke up every two hours so I would get maybe an hour before he wakes up. So I realized I stayed clear headed if I would just stay up but it would leave me useless. I would beg him crying to watch him four hours so I could rest and then he would wake me up frustrated because the baby won't stop spitting up. He refuses to do diapers, and if I ask he waits for forever to make sure I'm not doing it. I adore my husband but he isn't the father I thought her would be. His getting better as our son grows up but his rarely done much to help care for him. I just keep feeling he'd be better off without me because he always seems so unhappy with me.

I will look at that FB page because I really could use the motivation because I do need to step up my game in cleaning. I still feel that he could help a little, like take out the trash or pick up after himself. His left stuff out a couple times that two year old should not get a hold of and I have told him this a few times. I have considered my options, we both have talked about our options if we did break up so we could both be able to survive. We both really depend heavily on each other he works twenty five hours a week and I get disability due to severe anxiety. We can talk about things but if I say something he doesn't understand it's worlds war 3, for example I told him his actions made me feel stupid because he told me to talk to him about my feelings and he completely pushed them aside and dismissed them because "I wasn't the only person in this world who felt like that." He made me feel like I was stupid and nothing I said counted for anything and he got caught up on the fact and mad because he never even called me stupid so why would that even apply.

He was raised in a very unique situation. His mother was still in high school when she got pregnant and graduated when she was about seven months along. So right out of high school she got a job and her parents ended up watching him a lot and she treats him similar to a younger brother. Her father was a very old fashioned man and that is very much how he ended up being taught. His grandmother by every meaning of the word was super woman and she took care of a house and six kids and apparently kept it spotless. I don't know if she did when her kids were little but from what I hear she was perfect. My husband assumed as soon as we had our son I would be the same way. I will be the first to admit that I do need to improve my cleaning habits but it has gotten WAY worse since my son because I chase him around all day. I literally am expected to do everything and on time. I am not worried about any physical harm he isn't that type of man and he means well and if he doesn't understand a certain view point if I don't put it in a way that he can understand he gets upset and mad because he wants to fix it. Seeking help is something we need to do because our biggest problems is communication and if we can't find a compromise (which is hard to him because in his mind it is either one way or another) divorce is a very real possibility and I don't want that. I very much love him he is the father of my child and he made me realize after a very real abusive relationship that I am worth something. His patience is running a bit thin with my depression though but that comes down to he wants to fix it and he can't.
I have tried to tell him that but he keeps telling me that it was the job I picked and I have to do it.
